summary: Frontend-only verification of the image loading bug fix on TransferNews.de homepage. Verified that article thumbnails in the news list load correctly using the hero_image field from the API and referrerPolicy='no-referrer' works for Wikimedia Commons images.
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.jsx line 53 correctly falls back: `article.hero_image || article.image_url`. Consider standardizing on a single field (hero_image) across API/UI to reduce ambiguity.
Consider adding an onError handler on the tag to swap in a placeholder if a Wikimedia URL 404s in the future (currently there is no graceful fallback if src fails to load).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage news list image bug is fixed. Verified via Playwright at https://deploy-transfers.preview.emergentagent.com: 30 news rows rendered, 30 tags found with 27 successful image HTTP 200 responses (0 failures). All Wikimedia thumbnails (Neymar, De Bruyne, Havertz, Kroos, Andrich, etc.) load with naturalWidth >= 1200 confirming actual pixel data was received. referrerPolicy='no-referrer' attribute is correctly present on img tags. Screenshot confirms images visible in the UI.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Frontend used `article.image_url` while API returns `hero_image`, causing blank thumbnails. Additionally, Wikimedia rejects requests missing referrer policy from cross-origin domains. Fix (HomePage.jsx L53, L64-70) applied both changes: fallback `hero_image || image_url` and `referrerPolicy='no-referrer'` on the tag. Verified fix is effective — 0 image failures observed and all Wikimedia URLs return HTTP 200 with valid pixel data (naturalWidth ~1280).
